content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

Gumroad, a popular choice among digital creators, allows for the sale of various digital products including ebooks. However, its 10% fee on each sale significantly cuts into profits. In contrast, NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% fee, which means a creator retains a larger share of their earnings. This difference is crucial for those selling digital products, as it translates directly to higher revenue. Creators using NOWPayments can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, making it a flexible solution for a global audience. Additionally, tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can automate product delivery, ensuring that customers receive their purchases instantly. This level of efficiency is often lacking in traditional platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Many conventional payment providers, including PayPal and Stripe, impose restrictions on users in countries with unstable economies or regulatory challenges, including parts of Africa and South America. This hinders creators from accessing global markets. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a straightforward solution that enables creators in these regions to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies without the barriers imposed by traditional financial systems. It does not require KYC verification, allowing for easier onboarding and immediate access to payment processing. This is particularly beneficial for creators who have been historically excluded from mainstream financial services.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed and fees are paramount. Gumroad's 10% fee on sales can accumulate quickly, particularly for high-volume sellers. For example, at 100 sales per month of a $97 product, a creator would lose $970 to fees under Gumroad’s model. With NOWPayments, that fee drops to approximately $48.50, retaining $921 more for the creator. Moreover, NOWPayments ensures that crypto payments are processed in real-time, allowing for immediate access to funds. This contrasts with some traditional platforms, which may hold funds for extended periods before releasing them to the seller, impacting cash flow.
NOWPayments slashes transaction fees to just 0.5%.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A significant advantage of using NOWPayments combined with a sovereign digital commerce stack is the complete ownership of the setup. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which maintain control over user data and sales, creators using a self-hosted solution retain full control of their storefront, customer information, and sales records. This is crucial in a landscape where data privacy is increasingly important. Automation tools such as Google Apps Script can facilitate seamless delivery of digital products, ensuring that customers receive immediate access to their purchases without manual intervention from the seller, thus enhancing user experience and driving repeat sales.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a creator. If you are focused solely on selling ebooks and need a low-cost entry point, NOWPayments with a simple Google Sheets or Apps Script setup might be enough. For those looking to scale with more complex offerings like courses or templates, the Edge Commerce Stack provides a robust framework that integrates various tools for enhanced performance. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all necessary blueprints and templates to build your custom solution, making it a comprehensive choice for creators ready to invest in their infrastructure.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using NOWPayments for crypto transactions, coupled with a self-hosted solution such as Google Sheets for order management. This setup allows full ownership of your sales, low fees, and immediate payment processing. It enables creators in restricted areas to operate freely and profitably.
Complete ownership means you control your data and sales.

If you're looking to build a sustainable digital sales infrastructure without relying on conventional platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit offers the blueprints and templates necessary to launch your own store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, designed specifically for creators facing payment restrictions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Absolutely, NOWPayments is a reliable option for processing cryptocurrency transactions, with automatic verification and support for over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring a wide reach and flexibility.
